workouts.title: Week Overview
workouts.description: This is the deload week before the re-test week. You should feel pretty good all week.

workouts.title: Warmup
workouts.description:
A. General
2 sets
5/leg Single Leg Hip Thrust
5 Cal fast on bike erg
5/leg Face up chinese plank + knee drive 
(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SpSk8-Xkghg)
5 Box Jumps

B. Mobility
PNF Hamstring stretch
5 repetitions/side
- 5 seconds contraction, pushing against the band with your foot
- 5 seconds stretch, pulling your foot back with the band
(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1RohXn9h21c)
 
C. Specific
Clean Technical:
-5 Halting clean deadlifts
-5 Low hang clean pulls
-5 Front squat 1 1/4
-5 No feet, no hook, no contact muscle clean
